adjudication.rationale: Looking at the updateAllCalendarEvents method around line 542, the code processes multiple calendar references in a loop and pushes update promises to a result array. The method catches errors at line 589-608 but only logs them and returns error results - it doesn't rollback the database booking update that would have already occurred. The diff shows that when updating calendar events fails for some hosts, the booking database record may already be committed with new times while some host calendars retain old times. This is a real consistency issue where partial failures can leave the system in an inconsistent state between the database and external calendars.
